rules.assertion: Registry mutations must pass through a reviewed platform proposal and a provider admission capability; no direct edit.
A valid Registry state exists only after a provider returns authoritative content/state/admission identifiers.
Never render secret values.
Every page must render PageHeader with title and lede.
Interactive records open preview, not modal detail.
Natural language produces proposals, not direct execution.
Main surface must not expose raw engine jargon.
Technical detail belongs in preview.
Proposal assistance may interpret text, but the model/browser is never operational authority; the platform contract defines validity and the provider returns operational truth.
LAB report is calculated on load, not a cron report.
Sensors must show liveness/alive state explicitly.
Unregistered signals must be able to become Registry candidates or ghosts.
Machines page must show connectivity, access, jobs, maintenance, security and runtimes.
Receipts are proof ledger entries, not generic activity logs.
Ghosts can resolve through evidence into receipts.

demo_store.lab_report_markdown:
# Hello Daniel

Today is May 19th.

## What happened
- LAB 256 is online and ran the UI build.
- LAB 512 is alive but underused.
- One cleaning proof is still missing.

## This cannot wait
| Item | Why | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| LAB 512 idle | inference machine is not doing useful work | inspect jobs |
| Cleaning proof missing | physical routine did not close | add evidence |

## Suggested actions
- Inspect LAB 512 jobs.
- Register the unknown sensor signal.
- Resolve the cleaning ghost with evidence.

showcase_manifest.purpose: Render all components with canonical demo states for screenshot and visual audit.

rules.assertion: No component or page may create horizontal overflow at desktop width.
Avoid repeated explanatory text inside stacked cards.
Active nav item must show border/background/text/icon contrast.
Opening preview must keep middle legible.
Cards should stay low and compact unless page blueprint says hero.
Technical engine fields belong in preview or JSON detail.
List/table/workbench components must handle empty state.
Secret values must never render, including JSON preview.

api_contracts.stub_policy: Unavailable provider capabilities must render an explicit unavailable/degraded state; demo data may never impersonate provider truth.

intelligence.claim_policy: derived conclusions are candidates until registered/receipted

grid_contract.name: Operational Temperature Grid
grid_contract.purpose: A page-level layout contract that separates operational temperature from raw information density. Pages declare what is hot, warm, cold, and raw; renderers decide placement and disclosure from that declaration.

warm.purpose: active, monitored, relevant but not immediately blocking

cold.purpose: normal, stable, old, statistical, searchable, auditable

raw.purpose: technical payload, ids, JSON, debug/source details

warm.operator_question: What should be watched or kept in context?

cold.operator_question: What can be searched, audited, or reviewed later?

ColdTable.purpose: stable rows, inventory, old records, normal state

ColdStatusLine.purpose: healthy or normal metrics compressed into one line

ColdMetricStrip.purpose: small status chips for non-urgent counters

ColdBreakdownPanel.purpose: by domain, status, entity, machine, vendor, or workorder breakdowns

ColdAuditTrail.purpose: historical events, receipts, gate history, rotations, correspondence

ColdSearchHeader.purpose: search and filters for archive/navigation surfaces

ColdRelationsPanel.purpose: linked receipts, ghosts, gates, entities, docs, dependencies

ColdDocumentArchive.purpose: documents that are stable or not currently actionable

evidence.purpose: proof, missing proof, receipt, digest, source

runtimes.primary_question: Que runtime está quebrando, expondo ou habilitando capacidade operacional?

llms.primary_question: Qual inteligência está autorizada a fazer qual trabalho, com qual custo?

agents.primary_question: Quais papéis operacionais estão confiáveis, ausentes ou bloqueando workflow?

research.primary_question: Que afirmação estamos investigando, com qual evidência e qual confiança?

benchmarks.primary_question: Este resultado é comparável, reprodutível e suficiente para autorizar decisão?

code.primary_question: Que mudança foi proposta, que prova existe e quem pode aceitar?

reviews.primary_question: O que está sendo aceito, com base em quais critérios e por qual autoridade?

financeiro.primary_question: Que obrigação financeira exige ação, prova ou aprovação agora?

vendors.primary_question: De quais entidades externas o LAB depende e qual risco cada uma introduz?

legal.primary_question: Qual obrigação legal pode vencer, expor ou bloquear o LAB?

policies.primary_question: Esta regra está governando o sistema de forma útil, atual e comprovável?

gates.primary_question: Há autoridade e evidência suficientes para avançar estado?

secrets.primary_question: Que capacidade está bloqueada por secret ausente, stale ou inseguro?

connections.primary_question: Que integração externa está disponível, degradada ou bloqueando operação?

schedules.primary_question: O previsto aconteceu de fato, e que prova fechou isso?

analytics.primary_question: Que padrão sistêmico exige mudança de operação?

settings.primary_question: Que configuração altera comportamento real do sistema e exige cuidado?

expedicoes.primary_question: Que expedição está viva, bloqueada ou exigindo decisão agora?

research-profile.primary_question: Qual é a direção de pesquisa de longo prazo e que evidência sustenta mudanças nela?

milestones.primary_question: Que marco de pesquisa está bloqueado, mudou ou precisa de evidência para avançar?

short-term.primary_question: O que o plano de curto prazo exige agora e o que está impedindo execução honesta?
